test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

a) Some scarfs are shawls.

b) Some shawls are mufflers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some scarfs are mufflers.

II. Some mufflers are shawls.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
**Explanation: **

Statements:

a) Some scarfs are shawls.

b) Some shawls are mufflers.

The least possible venn diagram will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a899ce8c172d989917dbe757807ca8090d0a01b68c7143518ce29e8251365e0.png] 

We will check the conclusions.

 
• **Conclusion I.** Some scarfs are mufflers. → False (As there is no relation between scarfs and mufflers. So we cannot conclude it with surity.)
 
• **Conclusion II.** Some mufflers are shawls. →True (As Some A are B and Some B are A follows and Some Shawls are Mufflers is given in statement).

***​***Hence, **Only conclusion II follows** is the** correct answer.**
